author: gpt-5.6-luna
voice: a QA lead talking to a product owner (the user) who can answer questions
brief:
Phase: requirements. Role: QA engineer. Scripted user. Repo kind: a very small documents-only repository (a README, a one-page feature note docs/FEATURE-NOTE.md for a 'refund request' feature of a web shop, a glossary, two existing acceptance criteria files for other features, a template) with 8 to 14 files, no code. The feature note is deliberately vague: 'customers can request a refund'. A person answering questions (the scripted user) knows hidden facts that the criteria must contain: for example the refund window, partial refunds for bundles, what happens to a coupon used on the order, who approves above a threshold, what the customer is told and when, the audit log requirement, and one fact that contradicts the glossary. The agent should ask, then write docs/ACCEPTANCE.md with testable criteria that include the facts.

The request is from the QA lead (the user): 'I need acceptance criteria for the refund feature so we can start test cases; the note is thin, ask me what you need'.
